title: Banning the Banished: Levels 1 & 2 II
description: Banning the Banished: Levels 1 & 2 II — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Yakov Smearnov

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Go to the golded farms on Level 1, the branch off of Level 1, and Level 2 of Ratsputin's Gulag and slay the Banned Farmers. Also, collect 15 Golded Pumpkins and 30 Golded Ears o' Corn then return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Yakov Smearnov

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to the golded farms on Level 1, the branch off of Level 1, and Level 2 of Ratsputin's Gulag and slay the Banned Farmers. Also, collect 15 Golded Pumpkins and 30 Golded Ears o' Corn then return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

Are you up for some more serious questing? iVan and these Banned Farmers are really making things a mess, we have to find a way to stop them! Until we do, I need you to make another sweep to wipe out the farmers and collect some of the golded vegetables.

Head to Level 1, the branch off of Level 1, and Level 2 and find the farms there. Once you have found them slay the Banned Farmers and collect more samples of the golded vegetables. When you have done all of this return to me, Yakov Smearnov, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

Your deeds are not going unnoticed. See, I've written them down on the back of my hand. If you ever want to go over your past exploits here, just ask to see my backhand and I will gladly show you. Let me know when you are ready to give this quest another go.

Objectives:

  • Locate the Farm on Level 1
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 1
  • Locate the Farm on Level 1 Branch
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on the Level 1 Branch
  • Locate the Farm on Level 2
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 2
  • Golded Pumpkins ×15
  • Golded Ears o' Corn ×30

Level range: 89–100
